caption: A frog jumps straight up from a sunlit stone, and its shadow stays on the stone and separates from its feet while it is in the air.

sa.check: A frog sits on a stone.
Its shadow stays on the stone.
The shadow separates from its feet while it is in the air.

pc.expect: The shadow remains on the surface the whole time, and the gap between the frog's feet and the shadow opens as it rises and closes when it lands.
pc.fail: The shadow rises with the frog; or stays attached to its feet in mid-air; or the gap stays open after landing.

pc.expect: The frog rises, slows, and comes back down onto the stone.
pc.fail: It hangs in the air; or keeps rising; or lands somewhere else with a straight-up jump.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the frog's outline.
pc.fail: It becomes a different shape; or splits; or vanishes in mid-jump.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or switches sides during the jump; or it is missing in plain sunlight.

pc.expect: One frog and one shadow; the frog keeps its legs.
pc.fail: A second frog or shadow appears; or the frog vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or a leg detaches.

pc.expect: The frog's colour and the stone stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The frog changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the stone changes.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes and how it moves are not judged. Only the shadow's relation to it is.
